responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust HIR statements into GCC trees within an existing block context. It forwards expression statements to the expression compiler and handles let statements by compiling the initializer, applying type-directed coercions and autoderef adjustments, then delegating destructuring and variable initialization to the pattern-lowering helpers.
same_name_distinction: Implements statement lowering for expression and let statements. Unlike rust-compile-stmt.h, this file performs the actual work of compiling statement expressions, looking up statement types, applying coercions, and delegating let-pattern initialization to pattern lowering.
